title: A stone balustrade on 1729 Prairie's 18th Street wall
items: The Pullman house's low wall along 18th Street now carries the balustrade its photograph shows past the porte-cochère: a row of turned stone balusters under a moulded rail, level with the tall pier's cap, running east to the carriage way.

Read off J. W. Taylor's photograph no. 1445 through its solved camera: where the run starts and stops, how high the rail stands and how far apart the balusters are. The balusters' shape is borrowed from the house's own front stair, since the print draws each one about two pixels wide.
